headline: Tesla Model Y L comes to US with six seats at $62,000
summary: Tesla's Model Y Long Wheelbase starts at $61,990 with 325 miles of range
details: Tesla has launched the Model Y Long Wheelbase in the US and Puerto Rico, almost a year after its release in China. The vehicle features a three-row six-seat configuration with heated seats and touchscreen displays on the first and second rows.

The Model Y Long Wheelbase has a six-inch wheelbase extension, 325 miles of range, and can go from zero to 60 mph in 4.4 seconds. Buyers get free access to Supervised Full Self Driving for 12 months and 12 months of Supercharging for free.
The base price is $61,990, almost $22,000 more than the most basic Model Y and $12,000 more than the non-Long Wheelbase Premium variant. Deliveries will start between September and October this year.

headline_marked: Meta releases [[Pocket app for AI minigames]] on iOS, Android
headline: Meta releases Pocket app for AI minigames on iOS, Android
summary: Meta's new app lets users create and share AI-powered gizmos
details: Meta has soft-launched a new app called Pocket, aimed at creating generative AI games. The app allows users to make and share 'gizmos' using AI.
Pocket has been available on iOS and Android since June 29, but it's not accessible in the US. The app's listing describes it as 'a creative platform for making and sharing gizmos'.

The app's features include creating and customizing gizmos, as well as curating playlists of the best creations. Meta has been heavily investing in AI technology, including acquiring the team behind the Gizmo app earlier this year.
